study_design: Population-based prospective cohort study of Japanese men.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: To investigate the association between dairy products, calcium, and saturated fatty acid and prostate cancer in Japan, where both the intake of these items and the incidence of prostate cancer are low, we conducted a population-based prospective study in 43,435 Japanese men ages 45 to 74 years.
reason: The abstract analyzes newly diagnosed prostate cancer overall and does not mention or analyze an aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The relative risks (95% confidence intervals) comparing the highest with the lowest quartiles of total dairy products, milk, and yogurt were 1.63 (1.14-2.32), 1.53 (1.07-2.19), and 1.52 (1.10-2.12), respectively.
estimate_classifications.reason: The yogurt estimate concerns overall prostate cancer incidence, with no aggressive subtype specified.
